name: Stick Drop! [AURAS]
desc:
🎯 Welcome to Stick Drop

Fast hands. Faster reactions. One wrong move and 💥 BOOM.

Face off against another player in this intense 1v1 reaction duel where every second counts!

How to Play:

-Dropper: Choose which stick to drop and when
-Catcher: React fast and catch all 8 sticks before they hit the ground and explode 💥

👍 Like the game and join the group!

💻 Available on Desktop, Mobile, Console, and Tablet
